name: yaw_keeper
note: R1 yaw bearing keeper: chord through the cover3 turret, runs in the turntable rim groove (lift retention + yaw hard stops). Fixed to cover3.

name: R2_pin
note: R2 +s trunnion: clamped in the carrier arm (nyloc in the inner-face pocket); the 3.2 mm tip past the nut IS the pivot pin in the cross (blind dia 2.4 hole). Length is intentional.

name: R3_keeper
note: R3 roll keeper: across the gimbal cross, runs in the roll-shaft groove (axial retention + roll hard stops). Fixed to the cross; head on the -s face, hex nut on the +s face.

name: R4_bolt
note: R4 pivot: thumb metacarpal cheeks + roll-shaft tongue (J0-style through-bolt).

name: R5_bolt
note: R5 pivot: thumb metacarpal distal clevis + thumb proximal tongue (J0-style through-bolt).

name: R6_bolt
note: R6 pivot: thumb distal clevis + thumb proximal tongue (J0-style through-bolt).

name: T3_mount_1
note: T3 N20 gearbox face to the cup floor (tapped M1.6 holes of the gearbox front plate; if absent, glue the gearbox face to the floor).

name: T3_mount_2
note: T3 N20 gearbox face to the cup floor (tapped M1.6 holes of the gearbox front plate; if absent, glue the gearbox face to the floor).
